workflow: LangGraph adapts ordinary chat to the shared query service; selected material and streaming also reuse that service.

storage.Neo4j: Facts, source evidence and graph revisions
storage.Milvus: Document vectors; candidate collections are optional
storage.MySQL: Conversations, ingestion jobs, source versions and publication
storage.Files: Local recipe JSONL, original data and managed uploads

publication: Explicit extraction, human review and graph validation
limits: Candidate indexing and reranking are optional
LightRAG and Redis are not mandatory query dependencies
